title: Editor
blurb: The full Space3d editor in your browser: hierarchy, inspector, gizmos, undo/redo, texture and model editors.
controls: click to pick · drag the gizmo · Space plays/pauses

title: Hello cube
blurb: The smallest complete game: a lit, rotating cube.

title: Shield demo
blurb: 3D hull shields for SpaceCorps 2027: per-shot waves, piercing, break, a group bubble. Loads about 40 MB of ship models.
controls: click/Space fire · F Aegis · B break · R restore · 1–4 quality

title: Web demo
blurb: 4,096 instanced cubes in a single draw call.
controls: drag to orbit · wheel/pinch to zoom · tap to recolor · 1–3 patterns

title: PBR showcase
blurb: Materials, shadows and every blend mode in a top-down space scene.
controls: drag to look around · wheel/pinch to zoom

title: Graphics showcase
blurb: Every graphics feature in one reference scene.
controls: Q quality · 1 bloom · 2 shadows · 3 IBL · 4 distortion · C follow · arrows pan · wheel zoom

title: City at dusk
blurb: A rain-soaked procedural city: fog, SSAO, screen-space reflections, CC0 PBR assets and a camera flythrough.
controls: watch the flythrough · F free-fly (WASD, right-drag) · Q quality · P pause · H hide panel

title: Post processing
blurb: Bloom, FXAA, vignette, grain, grading — toggled live.

title: Particles
blurb: The particle library in a small space battle.

title: Particle stress
blurb: Streaming additive glows; the web budget is capped.

title: Instancing
blurb: A very large instance buffer with a travelling wave.
controls: drag to orbit · wheel/pinch to zoom

title: Physics playground
blurb: Rapier rigid bodies on the fixed tick: drop things and watch.
controls: click/tap drops a body · Space random · R rain · A/D orbit · wheel zoom

title: Save game
blurb: Collect coins; saves live in your browser's localStorage.
controls: arrows/WASD move · F5 save · F9 load
